name: How much does a home extension typically cost in the Los Angeles area?

mainEntity.name: How much does a home extension typically cost in the Los Angeles area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a home extension in Los Angeles varies significantly based on its size, complexity, materials chosen, and site conditions. A basic room addition might start from $200-$300 per square foot, while more complex or luxury extensions with high-end finishes can exceed $500 per square foot. This includes design, permits, labor, and materials. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation and assessment of your specific project requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for home extensions in Los Angeles vary widely, typically ranging from $200 to over $500 per square foot depending on size, complexity, and finishes.
